preToolUse.bash: if grep -qE 'rm -rf|DROP TABLE|git push --force' <<< "$TOOL_ARGS"; then echo '{"allowed": false}'; exit 1; fi; echo '{"allowed": true}'
preToolUse.powershell: if ($env:TOOL_ARGS -match 'rm -rf|DROP TABLE|git push --force') { @{allowed=$false} | ConvertTo-Json; exit 1 } else { @{allowed=$true} | ConvertTo-Json }
